ItemDesc: Upon use, immediately recovers HP for all allies equal to <unbreak>30%</unbreak> of their Max HP, and increases their DEF by <unbreak>20%</unbreak> for the next battle.
ItemBGDesc: A special salad offered by Shush, inspired by a cooking accident: A screw came loose, and a robotic arm fell into the salad being tossed. Shush has unilaterally denied this rumor, claiming everything was part of the plan. "A healthy body does indeed require a proper amount of 'iron.'" "...Does this look like the right amount to you?"
